# Command creator: author optimized Claude Code slash commands

Curated by Skill Harbor — @softaworks's command-creator: the skill to use when creating Claude Code slash commands. It walks through a six-step workflow — auto-detect the location (project .claude/commands/ vs global ~/.claude/commands/), show the four command patterns (workflow automation, iterative fixing, agent delegation, simple execution), gather name/purpose/arguments/steps/tool restrictions, generate the optimized command with bundled references (patterns, examples, best-practices), write the file, and confirm usage. Enforces kebab-case naming, imperative agent-optimized writing, explicit error handling and success criteria. MIT-licensed. Honest notes: it's a conversation-driven assistant, not a one-shot generator — expect it to ask you questions before writing anything; and the bundled reference docs live in the repo, so install the whole folder. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
